transcript.reasoning:
We need to produce platemap for Bradford assay. Liquids: samples duplicate => 20 samples *2 =40 wells with sample + maybe plus reagents. Also 8 wells of BSA standards already in plate - they contain BSA (standard) presumably pre-loaded. So destinations: we have 48 wells used: 40 sample duplicates + 8 standard wells. They likely want to fill 48 wells; remaining empty ignore.

Liquids needed: sample_i (duplicate), bradford_reagent (added 250ul to each used well), BSA standards already present (they stay as is). Possibly water? Not mentioned.

Thus liquids: sample_{i} (role sample, indexed, count 20, index number?). Since duplicates we treat as separate wells later via groups.

Bradford reagent: role reagent, bind name pattern "bradford|bradford reagent".

BSA standards: these are already in plate; they are samples? Could treat as sample_{std_i} but they are pre-loaded, we just declare they remain unchanged: volume declared. Use liquid named "bsa_std_{i}"? But request didn't specify naming; could treat as "bsa_std". However they are 8 wells each containing BSA standard (different concentrations?). Not given. Probably they are pre-made standards, we don't need to add anything, just note they are already there.

In platemap, for those wells we put {"declared": true? Actually spec says amount can be "declared" when well already held that liquid before the run and must keep all of it. So we use "declared". No volume number.

So liquids: sample_{i}, bradford, bsa_std_{i} maybe.

Destination select auto (since only one plate).

Variants: Since request doesn't specify which wells, we have free groups. Need two groups: one for sample duplicates (40 wells) and one for BSA standards (8 wells) already present (they are pinned? Actually they are already in plate at specific wells unknown, so free). We'll create one variant with two groups.

Group for sample duplicates: members each contain sample_i and bradford 250ul. Since duplicates, we need each sample appears twice. Could list members sequentially: sample_1 twice etc. Order hint index.

Group for BSA standards: members each contain bsa_std_i declared and bradford 250ul? Wait standards already in plate, then we add Bradford reagent to every well used, including standards. So standards get Bradford too. So each standard well: bsa_std_i declared + bradford 250ul.

Thus map.

Now call propose_platemap.
